summary: A shallow crater, green glass, a ledger of the numbers, and what followed.

paragraphs.text: By dawn the tower was gone, vaporised, with only its footings left. Beneath it was a shallow crater, {{crater}}. The desert sand had melted and fallen as a thin layer of green glass, now called trinitite, found out to {{trinitite_extent}}.
The ledger. The explosion released the energy of {{yield_kt}}, or {{yield_j}}. Only {{pu_fissioned}} fissioned. The mass that turned into that energy was {{mass_converted}}.
No single yield figure is final. Fermi's paper scraps gave {{yield_fermi}}. Radiochemistry gave {{yield_1945}}. A 2021 re-analysis of trinitite gave {{yield_2021}}.
Fallout drifted downwind: {{fallout_note}}. Twenty-four days after the test, on {{nagasaki_date}}, the same design was dropped on Nagasaki.

events.detail: Ground zero at dawn: a shallow crater, {{trinitite_extent}} of green glass, and the footings of the tower.
The picture dims and the numbers are set out one row at a time.
Fermi's scraps of paper, the 1945 and 1963 figures, and the 2021 re-analysis on one axis.
Fallout over ranches and villages, and Nagasaki on {{nagasaki_date}}.

callouts.text: Remnant of the cloud, far above this view, drifting away
